concept: 识别中间招的三步思路
question_cn: 发现中间招机会的正确思维步骤是哪个？
question_en: Which sequence of steps is the right way to find an intermezzo?

options.text_cn: ①确认对方有挂子或将军机会 → ②判断插入该步后对方是否被迫应对 → ③确认插入步后原来换子仍能完成
options.text_en: 1. Check for a loose piece or a chance to give check; 2. make sure the inserted move forces a response; 3. confirm that you can still complete the original exchange afterward

options.text_cn: ①计算最长变化 → ②选择吃最多子力的路线 → ③确认不被将死
options.text_en: 1. Calculate the longest variation; 2. choose the line that captures the most material; 3. make sure you are not checkmated

options.text_cn: ①先完成换子 → ②再寻找追击机会 → ③若仍有挂子再考虑吃
options.text_en: 1. Complete the exchange first; 2. look for a follow-up attack; 3. capture a loose piece only if one remains

options.text_cn: ①寻找所有将军步 → ②看能否将死 → ③否则放弃
options.text_en: 1. Find every available check; 2. see whether any gives checkmate; 3. otherwise abandon the idea

explanation_cn: 识别中间招的三步思路：①「停一下」——在换子序列中先不急着吃回，扫视棋盘是否有挂子（无根子/无充分保护子）或将军机会；②「强迫性」——插入的那步必须是将军、捉挂子等强迫步，让对方不得不先应对；③「收得回来」——应对后，原来的换子仍能完成，不亏子。三步都满足，就是可行的中间招。
explanation_en: Use three checks to spot an intermezzo: pause before recapturing and look for a loose piece or a check; ensure the inserted move is forcing and the opponent must respond; then verify that you can still complete the original exchange without losing material. When all three conditions hold, the intermezzo works.
